summary.interpretation: Counts describe package review state, not current site conditions or implementation approval.

assumptions.statement: The site and three key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional rough substitutes, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All dependent areas, partitions, figures, and ratios are temporary recomputations and cannot support parcel-, approval-, or implementation-level decisions.
assumptions.mitigation: Replace only with official or cleared CAD/GIS/PDF geometry carrying source, version, CRS, and conversion records; then regenerate every layer and metric.

assumptions.statement: Approved regulatory controls for FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks, building control lines, and development quantum are absent.
assumptions.impact: Land-use and building layers remain concept diagrams; no statutory intensity or approved capacity is claimed.
assumptions.mitigation: Reconcile the concept with approved regulatory planning conditions and applicable professional standards before any formal design conclusion.

assumptions.statement: Official road redlines, sections, station interfaces, traffic counts, parking, universal-access conditions, and safety reviews are absent.
assumptions.impact: The 100 m Human Loop pair and transverse links are relationship-testing centerlines, not engineering alignments or construction-feasibility findings.
assumptions.mitigation: Complete mobility, universal-access, emergency, transit-interface, and road-authority review with surveyed base data.

assumptions.statement: Cleared parcel boundaries, ownership, tenure, leases, easements, and implementation rights are absent.
assumptions.impact: No parcel is assigned for demolition, compulsory change, construction, or operation; project and phase polygons carry no land-right claim.
assumptions.mitigation: Undertake cadastral and legal due diligence and obtain all required owner/operator authorizations.

assumptions.statement: Current building footprints, heights, uses, age, structure, condition, occupancy, and code status are absent.
assumptions.impact: The twelve footprints are design prototypes only; they do not state what exists or what should be retained, renovated, or demolished.
assumptions.mitigation: Complete cleared survey, structural/fire/accessibility assessments, and stakeholder review before a retain-renovate-demolish schedule.

assumptions.statement: Official protection boundaries and construction-control zones for the Jing-Zhang railway heritage park and related heritage assets are absent.
assumptions.impact: Cultural paths, gardens, landmarks, and building prototypes are conservative concepts only and cannot authorize ground disturbance or visual-impact change.
assumptions.mitigation: Obtain heritage plans and approvals; conduct archaeology, setting, sightline, vibration, and interpretation review.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, subsurface conditions, drainage/flooding, sponge-city, fire access, power, communications, energy, and emergency conditions are absent.
assumptions.impact: No utility relocation, compute-energy capacity, drainage performance, fire route, or construction feasibility is claimed.
assumptions.mitigation: Complete surveyed multidisciplinary engineering, utility-owner, fire, flood, energy, cybersecurity, and emergency reviews.

assumptions.statement: Verified public-service inventory, accessibility demand, operating responsibilities, service levels, privacy/data governance, and non-AI equivalence tests are absent.
assumptions.impact: Human Help Courts and AI service scenarios are service-design hypotheses, not promised public provision or an operator commitment.
assumptions.mitigation: Co-design with residents and affected groups; confirm public operators, staffing, equal non-AI access, data minimization, appeal, incident, and performance protocols.

assumptions.statement: No approved implementation scope, cost plan, funding source, procurement path, operator agreement, insurance, construction program, or public authorization is supplied.
assumptions.impact: The three phases and one flagship pilot are sequencing concepts only; they are not investment, procurement, delivery, or government commitments.
assumptions.mitigation: After all preceding gates, prepare an independently reviewed business case, cost plan, permissions strategy, trial protocol, rollback plan, and accountable operator agreement.
